description: The Glowforge Pro is an enclosed desktop CO2 laser cutter and engraver. It cuts and engraves flat sheets of wood, acrylic, leather, paper and fabric, and it can engrave glass, stone and anodized aluminum. Students use it for prototypes, enclosures, signs and models. A lid camera lets you place designs directly on the material, and a passthrough slot lets you feed long boards through for oversized projects.

specs.label: Cutting area
specs.value: approx. 495 mm wide × 279 mm deep (19.5 in × 11 in)

specs.label: Maximum material size
specs.value: 515 mm (20 in) wide; 13 mm (0.5 in) thick with crumb tray, 50 mm (2 in) thick with tray removed

specs.label: Passthrough slot
specs.value: material up to 6.3 mm (1/4 in) thick, 20 in wide, any length

specs.label: Positioning precision
specs.value: 0.025 mm (0.001 in); engraving up to 1355 DPI

ppeRequired: CO2-laser-rated (10,600 nm) safety glasses whenever the Pro Shields are removed for passthrough work
useRestrictions: Only trained users may run it, never unattended, and only on approved laser-compatible materials (no vinyl/PVC, ABS, HDPE or galvanized metal), with the Pro Shields installed except during passthrough jobs.
